pin_policy: Pin the upstream commits matching the RELEASED build players run, not the tip of `upcoming`. Elite Redux cuts releases from `upcoming` with no tag or release branch. ABILITIES_COUNT is a necessary but NOT sufficient check -- it can hold across a long run of unreleased commits, so do not rely on it alone to pick a SHA. Earlier pins: v2.65beta (er-config 123fc66, 2026-03-27, fixed by direct observation of a real v2.65.3b ROM) and an Oct 6 pin (er-config 7285071) that turned out to be the original v2.65.4, not 4.1b: the eliteredux.net 'What's new' text and its 'Last Updated October 06, 2026' date match the v2.65.4 video uploaded 2026-10-07, and ER-nextdex labelled its Oct 6 sync 'in sync with 2.65.4' (ForwardFeed/ER-nextdex 8b7faf7). The current pin (v2.65.4.1b, the hotfix) is er-config 8b1d29d 'Energy ball is light move' (2026-10-19T02:02:27Z) with eliteredux-source dd34f57 'Update SavingVersionNumShort as well oops' (2026-10-19T04:32:59Z). Evidence: the source's in-game version string changes from 'v2.65 Beta2.1' to 'v2.65.4.1' in e239439 (04:25Z) and dd34f57 (04:32Z), and the next er-config commit (0505f4e, 14:34Z) comes 10 hours later; ER-nextdex re-synced its '2.65.4' data to er-config 8b1d29d on 2026-10-19 (ForwardFeed/ER-nextdex e26cee4, f1fdd77) -- that file has 1074 abilities, matching AbilityEnum.proto at 8b1d29d (ids 0-1073), and lacks the 0505f4e change (Minior's Photon Burst). Not independently confirmed: no upstream marker or dated release note exists for 4.1b, so the exact build time within 2026-10-19 04:32Z-14:34Z is inferred, and the source string was stale (Beta2.1) even at the 2.65.3b release, so on its own it is weak evidence. The next release, v2.65.5 (2026-11-02), is er-config 0572570 / eliteredux-source 60f7d52 per ER-nextdex d51e0c1 -- not pinned here. tests/test_oracle.py asserts ABILITIES_COUNT and species data against ER-nextdex's published (released-game) data -- keep that green when repinning.
